categories.main_business_segments: APT Medical Inc. focuses on the research, development, production, and sales of cardiovascular interventional medical devices. Its primary product lines include electrophysiology devices and consumables, coronary access products, peripheral vascular intervention products, and non-vascular intervention medical devices. The company also undertakes OEM manufacturing services for domestic and international clients.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed multiple core technologies such as steel wire reinforced extrusion, dissimilar alloy connection, hydrophilic coating technology, dual-mode electrophysiology navigation system, high-frequency power generation platform, controllable bending catheter technology, pressure sensing transmission, and high-pressure balloon forming processes. It integrates advanced materials science, biomedical engineering, software, and hardware development to innovate in catheter design, electrophysiology signal processing, and pulsed field ablation technology.
categories.primary_customers_markets: APT Medical serves hospitals and medical institutions primarily in the cardiovascular intervention and electrophysiology fields. Its customers include domestic hospitals across China, especially those performing electrophysiology and PCI surgeries, as well as international hospitals in Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and other regions. The company also collaborates with distributors and agents domestically and internationally.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with extensive hospital coverage nationwide. It has subsidiaries and sales operations in Hong Kong and Indonesia and exports products to over 90 countries and regions including Europe, the Middle East, Africa, Latin America, and the Commonwealth of Independent States (CIS).
categories.supply_chain_position: APT Medical operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the medical device supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and sales of interventional medical devices. It also engages in OEM manufacturing, providing contract manufacturing services to other medical device companies.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in electrophysiology and vascular intervention devices, emphasizing the development of pulsed field ablation technology and three-dimensional electrophysiology mapping systems. It invests heavily in R&D, maintaining over 14% of revenue allocated to research, and focuses on expanding product lines in coronary, peripheral vascular, and non-vascular intervention fields. Strategic plans include global market expansion, talent development, and enhancing manufacturing automation and quality systems.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of medical devices and consumables to hospitals and distributors. The company also earns income from OEM manufacturing services and provides related R&D and technical services. Sales are conducted mainly via a buyout distribution model domestically and internationally, supplemented by direct sales and delivery models in select regions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: APT Medical competes with major multinational medical device companies such as Johnson & Johnson, Abbott, Medtronic, Boston Scientific, and Terumo in the electrophysiology and vascular intervention markets. Domestically, it competes with emerging Chinese companies like MicroPort, Sinomed, and others. The company is recognized as a leading domestic innovator with growing market share, especially in electrophysiology consumables and coronary access products, and is advancing in pulsed field ablation technology to challenge foreign dominance.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 2.07 billion, representing a 25.18% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 673 million, up 26.08%. The company maintains strong profitability with a net asset return rate above 30%. It has steadily increased R&D investment and expanded production capacity, with total assets nearing RMB 3 billion and equity exceeding RMB 2.5 billion, reflecting robust growth and scale expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: APT Medical emphasizes its comprehensive product portfolio integrating advanced electrophysiology mapping and ablation systems with consumables, offering a unique pulsed field ablation solution that combines safety, efficacy, and precision. Its proprietary technologies such as controllable bending catheters, pressure sensing, and hydrophilic coatings provide superior clinical performance. The company leverages strong R&D capabilities, localized manufacturing, and regulatory approvals to deliver cost-effective, high-quality alternatives to imported products, supporting domestic substitution and global competitiveness.
